title: About 8 in 10 Americans take supplements, and many see them as important to their health
summary_en: About eight-in-ten U.S. adults say they are currently taking at least one supplement for their health, according to a new Pew Research Center survey.
title_cn: About 8 in 10 Americans take supplements, and many see them as important to their health

title: The U.S. Electorate’s Changing Racial and Ethnic Makeup
summary_en: The share of eligible voters who are White has declined since 2006, while the Hispanic and Asian shares have nearly doubled. The share of Black eligible voters has changed little over the same period.
title_cn: The U.S. Electorate’s Changing Racial and Ethnic Makeup
